high_level_description: The image depicts an elegant and ornate white sofa with gold accents. The sofa features intricate carvings on the arms and backrest, giving it a luxurious and regal appearance. The upholstery appears to be made of a shiny, possibly leather-like material, and the sofa is adorned with tufted buttons along its backrest, adding to its sophisticated design. In the background, there are several matching chairs with similar white upholstery and gold detailing. These chairs have a more traditional design with a higher backrest and armrests, each featuring a red cushion at the top.
